rust_locations.role: Excludes the upstream plain theme source for licensing and currently treats the known name exactly like an unknown theme.

claimed_invariant: A known but source-excluded theme remains a theme execution, not an unknown-name renderer hint. Its independently encoded behavioral declarations enter the same ordered theme-body stream as bundled themes, at the !theme directive epoch. Earlier user declarations are replaced property by property by the theme; later user declarations replace the theme. Renderers consume the resulting StyleProgram and ordinary skinparam metadata without branching on the theme name.
causal_divergence: Java executes the plain theme and resolves its root and class declarations through the normal style cascade. Rust deliberately omits the upstream source for licensing, leaving only __theme plain. The class renderer recognizes that marker and supplies three isolated defaults, so icon radius, icon paint, and text family match, while the class body remains #F1F1F1 with a #181818 half-pixel border at the default envelope origin. The frozen Java output instead has white class bodies, black one-pixel borders and arrows, and a five-pixel root document margin. The coherent displacement and paint cluster comes from one missing theme execution, not independent geometry constants.
planned_model_change: Add a general compatibility-profile path beside bundled theme-source lookup. Encode the plain profile from semantic palette and metric fields under RustUML's own Apache-2.0 source, generate sparse root and class declarations from those fields, and replay the generated body through the existing theme-tail mechanism. Preserve __theme as availability metadata, but remove renderer-local plain-name defaults once the ordinary style and skinparam paths supply them. Exercise the profile before and after user CSS and legacy skinparam declarations so source order, entity snapshots, and final link styling remain causal.

scope_boundary: This mechanism owns semantic loading and ordered replay for the known source-excluded plain theme profile. It does not bundle or reproduce the upstream theme file, alter permissively licensed themes, make unknown names load plain, change comparator tolerance, edit golden data, or key behavior to fixture labels, graph size, source coordinates, or rendered coordinates.

experimental_result.accepted_result: edge_theme_plain becomes structurally equivalent through render_svg without oracle input. The frozen shipped-path census rises from 11,163/11,251 to 11,164/11,251, with edge-cases moving from 752/777 to 753/777 and every other family unchanged.
experimental_result.model_evidence: A typed compatibility profile generates sparse root and class declarations and enters the existing relocated theme body at the !theme source epoch. The class renderer no longer inspects the theme name. Fresh renamed probes show that CSS and legacy skinparams before the directive are superseded by the theme, corresponding declarations after it win, the five-pixel margin follows the same order, and an unknown theme retains the ordinary unstyled defaults.
experimental_result.review_status: Implemented and locally verified; independent adversarial review and Java-generated held-outs remain pending because checker capacity and the local Java runtime are unavailable. This record does not self-attest acceptance.
